outcome: A model may launch one code-owned native prose-waiver window from either installed client, but only an operator click confirmed by macOS device-owner authentication can create a request-bound receipt that both projections verify.
practical_value: The machinery model cannot approve its own prose exception or make Kamen appear to have approved a choice he did not make, while Kamen never has to use a terminal.
stopping_condition: A model-supplied choice refuses; Kamen's native choice and macOS authentication produce an operator-attributed receipt accepted by start; both installed projections silently verify it; untrusted-shell reads, cross-request use, missing-proof, invalid-proof, and historical receipt shapes refuse; existing complete runs remain readable; both managed installs and the focused regression surface pass.
